_note: Costco Canada 'Offers Ending Sunday' (costco.ca/offers-ending.html), extracted with Claude in Chrome on 2026-10-02. PENDING Maxim's validation before any import. Single warehouse/region view (page header: 'Compare region updated', stock shown for Gloucester ON) - NOT verified national, unlike the coupons batch. The page shows 258 tiles at extraction (259 earlier the same hour). `productId` is Costco's catalog id from the tile (100…/4000…/4101…/4201…), NOT the 7-digit warehouse item number, so it cannot be matched to a receipt SKU without a lookup. Only tiles that show a 'was' price or 'After $X OFF' carry a discount; the rest list a current price only (no saving known). `url` is a canonical product link built from productId (the live slug was not stored).
validUntilNote: Inferred from the page title 'Offers Ending Sunday' (2026-10-02 is a Friday); the tiles carry no per-item end date.
